mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235, it indicates elevated inflation that triggers a monetary policy tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 235, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their respective 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer and business demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that typically prompts the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) trend indicates strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has increased over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the real GDP (GDPC1) falls below 16,000 billion dollars, it indicates a contraction in the economy that leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 is below 16000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains above 0.05%, it indicates a monetary policy stance that is insufficient to combat inflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 235 and FEDFUNDS > 0.05%, or the interaction term in a regression has a positive coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of robust housing market activity (HOUST > 1000), consumer confidence and spending increase, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
